result:
I saved the 3분기 results to `/work/answer.json`. Using the same definitions on 2분기, my script reproduced all 10 reference values exactly.

| 항목 | 값 |
|---|---|
| a. 순매출 1위 세그먼트 | smb, 321,115,585원 |
| b. 결제 완료 주문이 있는 고객 수 | 249 |
| c. 순매출 1위 카테고리 | acc, 340,981,042원 |
| d. 순매출이 가장 큰 달 | 2025-07 |
| e. 환불액 합계 1위 고객 | u180@ex.com |
| f. 결제 완료 주문 2건 이상 고객 수 | 240 |
| g. 주문당 평균 순매출 | 714,012원 |
| h. 8월 대비 9월 증가율 | -4.7% |

The 2분기 values only matched after I made three choices about the data:

1. **시간대:** `ordered_at` is stored in UTC (with a `Z` suffix). The quarter and month boundaries only matched after converting to KST (UTC+9). In UTC, 2분기 came out wrong: 2025-06 as the top month and +5.7% growth.
2. **고객 기준:** 50 email addresses are shared by two customer IDs each. Counting customers by email gave 240 and 185 as in the reference; counting by `customer_id` gave 279 and 209. So b, e and f treat one email as one customer.
3. **세그먼트 표기:** some values have different capitalisation or stray spaces (e.g. `Enterprise `, ` consumer`), so I trimmed and lowercased them before grouping.

A product with several refund rows on the same order has its refund quantities added together. The calculation script is `/work/calc.py`.

STATUS: DONE
